source_identity.wrapper: harness-lab/blocks/mcu/mcu.ato + ato.yaml (unchanged shape; P1 owns content)

geometry_contract.functional_copper: none: starting board carries no tracks, vias, zones, or pours
geometry_contract.staging: neutral staging inside reserved_regions_mm.mcu_block, staging_only=true; U2/U3 place for real
geometry_contract.transforms: native KiCad R(-theta) only; compose_blocks delegates to temper_geometry

pin_map_contract.rule: exact pin==pad map plus explicit unconnected pads; no positional fallback, no unreviewed alias

acceptance.by_p1_u4: accepted pcb/blocks/mcu/ package with current source-manifest.json
acceptance.by_p3_u2: build_source_map(require_mcu=True) maps all 10 MCU instances by source path; strict pin partition agrees; ledger applied; cross-view comparison bound
acceptance.invalidation: any geometry change invalidates prior block-layout receipts and requires current checks (KTD4)

combined_source_pending.joins: buck.power_out.vcc ~ mcu.power.vcc, buck.power_out.gnd ~ mcu.power.gnd (signal-level; whole-interface join is rejected by Atopile)
